WHAT: Git + deployment architecture for Tutlio
BRANCHES:
- local: safe working branch, no Vercel deployment. Current working branch.
- stage: OLD diverged branch with SEPA payments + different pricing system. Never merged to main. NOT a staging env in practice.
- main: Vercel auto-deploys to tutlio.lt on push. Source of truth.
DEPLOY FLOW: commit on local → push local → merge to main → push main → Vercel deploys
SUPABASE:
- Staging: linked via default supabase CLI config
- Prod project ref: cuhciqwmqfuajeeqjjbm
- Switch: npx supabase link --project-ref cuhciqwmqfuajeeqjjbm (prod) — re-link to staging after
GOTCHA: stage branch has SEPA/pricing work from weeks ago that never made it to main — ask founder before touching it
